title: Expand API and desktop docs with examples and troubleshooting
description: Add realistic examples, failure behavior, and related-link style sections to API and desktop pages most relevant to capability routing.
action: Modify content-api.ts and content-desktop.ts to include sections named '请求示例', '失败行为', '相关页面' for Gateway/API and desktop capability pages. Ensure Gateway API mentions base URL http://localhost:8000 and health/config/model troubleshooting sequence.

convergence.definition_of_done: API and desktop readers see concrete examples and know how to troubleshoot common failures.

files.change: Add request examples and failure behavior sections.
Add troubleshooting and related page sections.

implementation: In gateway-api content, add '请求示例' with GET /health and POST /chat examples without secrets.
In health-api/config-api content, add '失败行为' explaining Gateway down, missing model, masked secrets, and config reload checks.

In editor-integration/llm-integration/wiki-system desktop content, add '故障排查' and '相关页面' sections linking conceptually to guides/capability-routing, api/gateway-api, api/health-api, desktop/wiki-system.
Avoid adding endpoint names not present in API_REFERENCE.md unless already allowlisted by docs-lint.

rationale.chosen_approach: Examples and troubleshooting make detailed docs actionable without changing application code.
rationale.tradeoffs: More examples require API accuracy checks.

risks: Endpoint examples can drift from API_REFERENCE.
